name: b33_route_v8
what: Waypoints for b33_drive.ps1 (W2DEV) v3.1f, PROPOSED from the DEV rehearsal surveys 1-5 (NOT-PREREG) and the DEV kerb survey v2. DIAGNOSTIC tool input, not evidence; path design for the drive, not a measurement threshold; the official route is fixed only by the B-9 survey addendum on the candidate. A waypoint is [x, y] or [x, y, expected soles z] (sender log frame, measured where given).

dry_run_terrain.what: A MADE-UP rectangle model used ONLY by -DryRun to exercise the drive's logic offline. NOT the game's geometry; v3 shapes it after rehearsals 1-2 and the kerb survey: the path between raised kerb strips, the strip's east edge at x 195 with a terrace (z 35) and the slab (z -11.8) beyond. v4 adds rehearsal 3's step (z 27.5) and terrace (z 35.6) south-east of the kerb. v5 adds rehearsal 5's trough (z 51) between the path's north end and the strip, the path's lower east lip, and starts the strip at x 118. v6 adds the landing area east of the kerb as rehearsals 3 and 6 found it: the wall at x ~308 north of y 4380, the landing ground, the ramp up to the terrace, the terrace and its SE stairs down to the slab. v7 adds the slab's south side (y ~3282) and the two flights of stairs rehearsal 1 walked down (strip -> terrace -> slab).
